about.label: Who We Are
about.heading: Two Decades of Legal Excellence
about.body1: Celen LawFirm is a full-service law firm based in Ankara, Turkey. We are a mid-sized practice with a national and international client base. Our expertise includes but is not limited to corporate and commercial law, employment and labour law, pharmaceutical and healthcare law, consumer law, litigation, competition law, international law, and tax law.
about.body2: Founded on the principles of integrity, diligence, and strategic thinking, we have built lasting relationships with clients ranging from multinational corporations to individuals seeking trusted legal counsel. Our approach combines traditional legal craftsmanship with modern efficiency.

pageHeader.label: Practice Areas
pageHeader.heading: Our Areas of Expertise
pageHeader.subtext: Comprehensive legal services tailored to protect your interests and advance your objectives

corporate.title: Corporate and Commercial Law
corporate.desc: Our attorneys focus on corporate legal work including formations, structuring, tax advisory, due diligence, memoranda writing, drafting documents, and state filings. We routinely draft commercial contracts, corporate resolutions, and shareholder agreements for owner-managed businesses and represent clients in transactional disputes.

employment.title: Employment and Labour Law
employment.desc: We guide businesses and executives through the complex framework of labor laws. Our services include workplace policies, wage-and-hour compliance, discrimination defense, executive compensation, and representation before arbitration panels and labor courts to secure optimal resolutions.

healthcare.title: Pharmaceutical and Healthcare Law
healthcare.desc: Advising life sciences companies, medical institutions, and practitioners on the rigorous regulatory environments surrounding medical devices, pharmaceuticals, clinical trials, and healthcare compliance, bridging the gap between healthcare innovation and regulatory mandates.

consumer.title: Consumer Law
consumer.desc: Our firm is dedicated to protecting consumers against unfair commercial practices, deceptive marketing, defective products, and predatory lending. We represent clients in individual actions and class litigation while advising companies on complying with consumer standards.

litigation.title: Litigation
litigation.desc: Our litigators are well-versed in representing clients across civil, commercial, construction, and contract disputes. We aggressively advocate for clients in state courts, appellate hearings, and international arbitration tribunals, focusing on cost-effective, strategic dispute resolution.

competition.title: Competition Law
competition.desc: Navigating modern antitrust and competition laws requires deep strategic insight. We represent corporate clients in cartel investigations, merger clearances, abuse of dominance inquiries, and provide preemptive compliance audits to minimize anti-competitive risks.

international.title: International Law
international.desc: Specialized legal services addressing cross-border commercial transactions, international trade disputes, customs regulations, maritime issues, and compliance with bilateral treaties, serving as a trusted global counsel in multi-jurisdictional matters.

tax.title: Tax Law
tax.desc: Providing comprehensive corporate and private tax advisory to structure business transactions, cross-border deals, and estate plans in the most tax-efficient manner, helping clients successfully resolve complex audits and tax authority disputes.

faq.label: Frequently Asked
faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.q1: What should I bring to my initial consultation?
faq.a1: Please bring any relevant documents, correspondence, contracts, or court papers related to your matter. Also bring a form of identification. The more information you provide, the better we can assess your situation.
faq.q2: How are your legal fees structured?
faq.a2: Our fee structure varies depending on the nature and complexity of the matter. We offer hourly rates, fixed fees for certain services, and retainer arrangements. We will discuss fees transparently during your initial consultation.
faq.q3: Do you offer services in languages other than English?
faq.a3: Yes, our team includes fluent speakers of Turkish, French, German, Spanish, and Arabic. We can also arrange interpreter services for other languages as needed.
faq.q4: How do I know if my online communications with the firm are secure?
faq.a4: We use encrypted email and a secure client portal for document exchange. Look for 'https://' in the URL and never share passwords via email. For more information, visit our Online Security page.
faq.q5: What geographic areas do you serve?
faq.a5: While based in Ankara, Turkey, we serve clients nationally and internationally. We have experience with cross-border transactions and can coordinate with correspondent firms worldwide.
